description: This file implements an image optimization server function for Next.js, handling image requests, caching, upstream fetching, image processing, and response handling.

methods.name: imageOptimizer
methods.description: Main function to handle image optimization requests, including validation, caching, upstream fetch, image processing, and response.

methods.name: writeToCacheDir
methods.description: Writes optimized image buffer to cache directory with expiration and etag.

methods.name: sendResponse
methods.description: Sends image buffer as HTTP response with appropriate headers, handling etag and cache control.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeType
methods.description: Determines supported MIME type based on Accept header and available options.

methods.name: getHash
methods.description: Generates a SHA-256 hash from input items, used for cache keys and etags.

methods.name: parseCacheControl
methods.description: Parses Cache-Control header into a map of directives.

methods.name: getMaxAge
methods.description: Calculates max-age in seconds from Cache-Control header string.
